import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to;
        long rev;
        long capacity;
        long cost;
        long p;

        Edge(int to, long rev, long capacity, long cost, long p) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.p = p;
        }
    }

    static final int T = 99;
    static final long INF = 1L << 60;
    static final int C = 12;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int size = 50 * T + 2;
        List<List<Edge>> graph = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;

        // Helper method to add edges
        BiConsumer<Integer, Integer> addEdge = (a, b) -> {
            graph.get(a).add(new Edge(b, graph.get(b).size(), 1, 0, 0));
            graph.get(b).add(new Edge(a, graph.get(a).size() - 1, 0, 0, 0));
        };

        // Read k nodes and connect to source
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge.accept(source, a);
        }

        // Add edges for time layers
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            addEdge.accept(1 + t * n, sink, INF);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    addEdge.accept(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        // Read m edges
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            int b = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    addEdge.accept(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    addEdge.accept(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long totalFlow = 0, totalCost = 0;
        long[] dist = new long[size];
        long[] potential = new long[size];
        int[] parent = new int[size];
        int[] parentEdge = new int[size];

        // Min-Cost Max-Flow using successive shortest path
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[source] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            pq.offer(new long[]{0, source});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] d = pq.poll();
                long dd = d[0];
                int u = (int) d[1];
                if (dd > dist[u]) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < graph.get(u).size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = graph.get(u).get(i);
                    if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[u] + e.p + potential[u] - potential[e.to] < dist[e.to]) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.p + potential[u] - potential[e.to];
                        parent[e.to] = u;
                        parentEdge[e.to] = i;
                        pq.offer(new long[]{dist[e.to], e.to});
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[sink] == Long.MAX_VALUE) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                if (dist[i] < Long.MAX_VALUE) {
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                }
            }
            long df = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int u = sink; u != source; u = parent[u]) {
                Edge e = graph.get(parent[u]).get(parentEdge[u]);
                for (Edge e2 : graph.get(parent[u])) {
                    if (e2.to == u && e2.capacity > 0) {
                        df = Math.min(df, e2.capacity);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int u = sink; u != source; u = parent[u]) {
                Edge e = graph.get(parent[u]).get(parentEdge[u]);
                for (Edge e2 : graph.get(parent[u])) {
                    if (e2.to == u && e2.capacity > 0) {
                        e2.capacity -= df;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                for (Edge e2 : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (e2.to == parent[u]) {
                        e2.capacity += df;
                        totalCost += df * e2.p;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            totalFlow += df;
        }

        if (totalFlow != k) {
            System.out.println(-1);
        } else {
            System.out.println(totalCost);
        }
    }
}
